## How to use templates responsibly

1. Keep only sections relevant to the change.
2. Replace example data with verified facts.
3. Use synthetic prompts and remove private material.
4. Link test runs and exact commit SHAs.
5. Record not-applicable decisions with a reason.
6. Never present an unchecked template as evidence that a review occurred.
